jo-recruiter: FYI Priya is set to start 2026-09-01. Spouse is switching from H1 to H4 and filed the change of status + H4 EAD concurrently. Receipt issued but no SSN/EAD yet. Priya asked whether we can: 1) enroll spouse effective on start date, and 2) backdate coverage to start date if SSN/EAD comes later. cc @maria-peopleops
maria-peopleops: Quick take: vendors sometimes allow provisional enrollment effective day 1 with receipt notice. Backdating usually depends on vendor policy and plan terms. We'll need to collect the I-797C, marriage cert, and passport. Which carrier?
priya-newhire: Uploaded docs here: https://drive.company/boxed/priya/imm (I-797C # ends 5566). Carrier is UnitedHealth for our group. Prefer not to have coverage gap.
imm-attorney: Legal: UnitedHealth often accepts receipt for provisional dependent enrollment but their rules about retroactive effective dates vary. Document everything and set a 60-day tickler to supply SSN/EAD. If coverage needs to be retroactive, vendor may require evidence of eligibility as of the start date (receipt date earlier than start helps). If EAD/SSN issued later, provide copies immediately.
derek-hiringmgr: From team perspective we should avoid payroll surprises. If vendor charges retro premiums we'll evaluate covering employer portion. Noted.
benefits-admin: I'll open a ticket with UnitedHealth and request provisional enrollment with effective date 2026-09-01. We will flag the record as "pending SSN/EAD". UnitedHealth policy: they may accept the receipt for enrollment but will not confirm retroactive eligibility until they receive final docs; retro adjustments possible.
maria-peopleops: Thanks. Two operational notes: 1) if vendor denies provisional enrollment we can enroll spouse in COBRA-like temporary plan but employee would pay employee portion; 2) finance can approve employer-share coverage for up to 30 days to avoid a gap if hiring manager requests it. Please confirm if Derek wants that.
derek-hiringmgr: Approve covering employer share for up to 30 days. If extended, route to finance for exception.
priya-newhire: Appreciate it. If UnitedHealth asks for SSN/EAD after start, do I upload to the same drive or email benefits?
maria-peopleops: Upload to drive and email benefits@redwood with subject "Priya - dependent SSN/EAD". We'll update UnitedHealth and payroll. Also please note receipt and vendor case number in the folder.
imm-attorney: Add compliance note: keep a short entry in the HRIS: "Provisional dependent enrollment with USCIS receipt dated [receipt date]; SSN/EAD pending; follow-up due within 60 days."
benefits-admin: UnitedHealth case opened: UH-3345. They accepted provisional enrollment for 9/1 pending SSN/EAD. If SSN received later they will reconcile retro premiums. I'll post any follow-up.
jo-recruiter: I'll message Priya to confirm the plan and remind her to upload final docs if received. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
priya-newhire: Thanks team! Glad start date stays. :smile:
